surface_features: more than one comment vs exactly one
constructs.theoretical_construct: breadth of counter-argument exposure (multiple distinct counter-argument comments)

features.name: multiple_counter_comments
features.definition: Does the discussion contain more than one counter-argument comment (versus exactly one)?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments as JSON list; df['multiple_counter_comments'] = 1 if len(list) >= 2, 0 if len(list) == 1. Empty list gives 0 (valid empty input; none observed in data); missing/malformed gives null.

h0: multiple_counter_comments has no association with the likelihood of view change.
h1: Discussions with multiple_counter_comments = 1 have a higher likelihood of view change than those with a single comment.
note: Comment count is list length, not verified distinct commenters or semantically distinct arguments; "distinct" is operationalized as separate list entries. All rows have at least one comment. The list may be a sample/subset of the discussion and may include comments after the view change; timing is unknown. Association only, via OLS (linear probability) on delta.
